supported_profile.platform: The single live published root Platform Expert has completed its normal boot mapper decision; platform restart/replacement, external calls to setMapperRequired and external writes to IOMapper::gSystem are outside this profile.
supported_profile.provider: The exact retained, opened PCI provider has no iommu-parent property; the same retained published Platform Expert has no kIOPlatformMapperPresentKey property.
supported_profile.negative_wait_guard: An atomic gSystem == nullptr observation only rejects potential waiting. Unknown (1), Required (2), live mapper and all other values refuse before calling a factory. Null alone never admits a policy.
supported_profile.positive_attestation: Create a real IODMACommand with kBypassed and no explicit mapper; require a non-null accepted command and repeat all real platform/provider observations before releasing the probe.
supported_profile.actual_dma_commands: Every Direct allocation uses kBypassed, never kUnmapped. Preparation and each generated page must equal the original CPU physical backing and satisfy the requested address width.
supported_profile.revalidation: Repeat positive attestation for every policy query, before and after initial DMA mapping, and before and after retained-map reactivation; refuse changed platform/provider metadata without releasing retained pages or IOVA.
supported_profile.scalar: NV_TRUE selects NVIDIA explicit DMA callbacks for CPU physical PTEs. No NV_FALSE bypass-PTE path is implemented.

bounded_factory_argument: IOMapper.h:68-73 defines NoMapper=0, Unknown=1, HasMapper=2 and WaitMask=3; checkForSystemMapper only waits for flag values.
IOMapper.cpp:64 initially publishes Unknown. setMapperRequired at 143-153 can write Required/None; IOMapper::start at 118-122 can publish a live mapper.
IOPlatformExpert.cpp:157 calls setMapperRequired from its mapper-present property before setPlatform(this) at 175 publishes the platform. This is its only setMapperRequired call.

Within the normal already-published PE boot lifecycle there is no transition from settled None back to Unknown/Required. A later system IOMapper can only replace None with a live mapper, which kBypassed rejects without entering the sentinel wait.
IODMACommand.cpp:293-295 resolves the real system mapper for kBypassed; 326-330 rejects kBypassed when a mapper exists. kUnmapped would skip resolution and is not proof.
This is a supported boot-lifecycle source argument, not a general timed IODMACommand API. If the profile cannot be established, Direct remains unavailable.
remaining_limits: No hardware flags, firmware readiness, GPU initialization, IRQ delivery or platform power lifetime are established by this route.
The probe can fail for allocation pressure; failure remains closed and preserves query output.
No timeout wrapper can safely make the original sentinel wait bounded; the route refuses unresolved/required states before factory entry.
Retirement retains the existing finite pool and does not prove full RM initialization allocation capacity.
